items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1962-01-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Was he any relation to George? The one they called Pops Foster? [INTERVIEWEE] No. No.

ctx.x: My daddy was. Your daddy was but not your mama. My mother. She was younger than him. My daddy was ten years old in slavery. Ten years old.
I was going to ask her about the bass player there. Foster. Was he any relation to George? The one they called Pops Foster?
